name: Screensaver
description: Idle screensaver for Push 3. After a configurable idle timeout it takes over the display with an animation (Rainbow / Twinkle / Starfield), pads and buttons glowing along; any pad/button/encoder wakes it. Configured on-device via push-manager's Shadow UI (SAVER tab). REQUIRES push-manager + push-display installed and running (it draws through push-manager's display API).
